source.name: Pac-Man
observed: TSR identifies the asset as a 1456x599 PNG and exposes three named animated previews: Arm rise, Run (left), and Run (right).
Exact full-sheet PNG SHA-256 and dimensions were verified through the authorized phone lane before extraction.
The complete sheet was inspected as one source surface and presents a dense product space of repeated character-state cells rather than one self-evident linear timeline.
Run (left) and Run (right) TSR preview GIFs each contain 8 frames, each held 60 ms, for 480 ms total.
Arm rise TSR preview GIF contains 5 frames with measured durations 500/150/100/500/100 ms, demonstrating a different nonuniform preview schedule.
source.rights_note: Copyrighted source sheet and preview GIFs were used only as analysis evidence. No source pixels, palette, contours, layout, animation frames, tracing, redistribution, or close imitation are stored in this specimen. The shipped rig and video are abstract ASCII geometry authored independently.

sheet.inspection_note: Exact full sheet bytes were fetched through the authorized Home Center -> primary-phone lane; a transient reduced whole-sheet visual canary was inspected only for analysis and is not tracked or embedded.

source.timing_scope_note: OBSERVED timing here means measured TSR preview GIF exposure, not a claim of original game-runtime authenticity.

Original game display refresh, hit-stop, game-state windows, cancel windows, or input cadence.

thesis: A measured timing profile may be evidence-equivalent across orientation variants without turning the orientation axis into extra time. Source-preview timing and authored ONES/TWOS/FOURS compilation remain separate claims.

timing_doctrine.FOURS: one drawing/key held four display frames
timing_doctrine.ONES: new drawing/key sample every display frame
timing_doctrine.STREET_FIGHTER/CAPCOM: nonuniform gameplay timing may mix anticipation holds, fast transitions, impact/hit-stop candidates, recoil/recovery holds, silhouette exaggeration, and selective sampling; inferred timing is never reported as source-authentic
timing_doctrine.TWOS: one drawing/key held two display frames
